name: Calc2Pay
description: Calc2Pay is a professional billing calculator for small businesses — grocery shops, medical shops, tea stalls, restaurants, and more. Calculate the bill with built-in GST/discount/tax, then generate a payment QR encoded with the shopkeeper's own UPI ID. The customer scans and pays directly through their own UPI app — Calc2Pay never processes or touches the payment itself.
features: Smart calculator with GST, discount, tax and round-off built in
Bill Builder: itemized line items with quantity, unit and price
Instant UPI payment QR generation from your own Payment ID
Shop Profile, Products catalogue with barcode scan/generate
Import products from Excel or CSV with a downloadable sample sheet
Bill history: search, duplicate, favourite, share, print
Share any bill as a PDF straight from Create Bill
Reports: daily/weekly/monthly/yearly sales trends with charts
Branded PDF receipts and Bluetooth thermal printer support (58/80mm)
Voice Calculator and voice product entry
Optional Cloud Backup to your own Google Drive (Pro)
Works fully offline — all data stays on your device
Light and dark themes, with six colour palettes to choose from
